中文名: Modelica 模型库与模型工作流
中文功能定位: 仅在已应用 `ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules` 且任务明确要求对 Modelica 模型库或 Modelica 模型执行新建、修复、扩充、规范化、审查、本地化或交付整理时，使用本 skill；也适用于与之直接相关的包结构规范化、Examples / Tests 补齐、图形修复、中文化、本地化或交付准备任务。
英文功能定位: After `ty-sysplorer-modeling-rules` has been applied, use this skill only when the task explicitly asks to create, repair, extend, normalize, review, localize, or prepare delivery for a Modelica library or a Modelica model, or to perform closely related tasks such as package-structure normalization, example or test completion, diagram repair, Chinese localization, or delivery preparation.
中文分类: 模型开发调试（Model Development & Debugging）
